newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Excel Realty target raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Excel Realty target raised.

text.p: -- Prudential analyst Jim Sullivan said he boosted his target price on Excel Realty Trust Inc to $27.50 from $25.50 but cut his earnings estimates on the company to reflect a higher number of shares outstanding.

-- The analyst said his lower earnings estimates merely reflected the impact of additional shares resulting from a secondary offering announced last week. "It's basically a very positive call," he said of his outlook for the company.
-- Sullivan cut his estimate for Excel's fourth quarter to $0.61 per share from $0.62, cut his 1997 year estimate to $2.50 from 2.55.
-- He said he initiated an estimate of $2.75 per share on Excel Realty for 1998.
